Always use this skill for "olvm", "oracle linux virtualization manager", "ovirt engine", "rhv manager", "host non operational", "storage domain inactive", "storage domain low space", "vm paused", "vm not responding", "engine certificate expiring", "engine backup", or "what failed in olvm" when the context is an OLVM / oVirt engine. Do NOT use for XCP-ng — use xcpng-aiops. Do NOT use for Proxmox VE — use proxmox-aiops. Other hypervisors, NAS appliances, backup suites and container clusters are out of scope (negative routing hints only). Read-only in this release, with a built-in governance harness (audit, token budget, risk tiers).
skills.name: OLVM AIops
